title: fix(app-shell): one app opens under one address — name-alias routes move onto the package id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FP9GUkjfjntrFmztxSoedK)_

Fixes #26183

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

ADR-0048 §3.6 makes the package id the canonical `/apps/SEGMENT` key ("Canonical = package id"), and objectui#11818 / #11887 moved the app-independent links onto it. The sidebar was already right: `UnifiedSidebar` builds `basePath` from `appRouteSegment(activeApp)`, and `resolveHref` in `@object-ui/layout` builds object (with or without `viewName`), component, page, dashboard, report and doc entries on that `basePath`. So the obligations entry and the approvals inbox in the card are on the canonical address.

The second family came from the app NAME alias. `matchAppBySegment` resolves a name, `AppContent` then keyed every path it builds on the URL's own segment (`appSegment = appName ?? …`), and two landing producers emitted the name: `resolveDeclaredHomePath` (top-bar logo, Home) and the console's `resolveLandingPath` (the post-login `/`). Landing on `/apps/clm` kept list rows, record pages and related lists on `clm`, while every sidebar click went to `app.objectstack.hotclm`.

## What changed

- `utils/appRoute.ts`: `appAddressSegment(apps, app)`, the one address of an app: its package id when that resolves back to the same app, else its name (a package that ships several apps shares one package id, which opens the first). `canonicalAppPathname(apps, segment, pathname)`, the alias route rewritten onto that address, or `null` when it already carries it. It cannot loop: its answer resolves back to the same app.
- `console/AppContent.tsx`: a name-alias route is moved onto the address with `replace`, keeping the path, query string, hash and history state. This runs in an effect, so a layout already on screen is not unmounted. `appSegment` now keys on the matched app's address, so the recent-items tracker never records the alias.
- `utils/homePath.ts` and the console's `RootLandingRedirect.tsx`: both landings name the address directly, so no redirect hop follows. They still agree, and `landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts` gains two cases for that.

Old addresses still open. A name-based bookmark or shared link resolves through the alias as before and then lands on the package id.

## Tests

- `AppContent.nameAliasRedirect-26183.test.tsx` (new, a real `AppContent` mount): the alias moves onto the package id with search, hash and state kept, as a `REPLACE`. Controls that do not move: the package-id route, an app whose name is its package id (no loop), and the second app of a shared package.
- `appRoute.test.ts`: `appAddressSegment` and `canonicalAppPathname`, covering no loop, name equal to package id, package-less apps, a shared package, and segments outside `/apps`.
- `homePath.test.ts`, `RootLandingRedirect.test.ts`, `landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts`: the landing names the package id. Two existing pins changed address because of this: declared Setup now lands on `/apps/com.objectstack.setup`, and Studio alone on `/apps/com.objectstack.studio`. What each pin checks (which app is the landing) is unchanged.
- `AppContent.recentOnPackageRoute-11818.test.tsx`: its alias CONTROL now records the visit once, on the package-id address.

Local run results are in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- The many hardcoded `/apps/setup/…` links in the console still work, now with one replace-hop onto `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/…` for a session whose app list carries Setup. Moving those producers onto `resolveHostAppSegment` is not part of this PR (carrier: none).
- The ADR-0048 §3.6 per-tenant friendly alias (namespace → package id) is still unbuilt. The name alias this PR rewrites is not that alias.
